scope: Manual section/metadata editing through the shared caller-RLS server handlers and review page. Local source/unit/build verification only; unchanged reviewed SQL/native evidence is retained separately.
completed: Confirmed both prior manual handlers lacked a browser-version predicate and could overwrite a newer edit; section clearing used a truthy fallback that restored the old value.
Requests require loaded viewer/student/document/review identity and the exact microsecond revision; current canonical edit/document-view and non-partner-only checks run under the caller context.
The UPDATE itself matches review/student/document/revision/editable status. Missing, completed or concurrently edited rows are not recreated or retried.
Section patches preserve recorded originals and omitted state/value/notes; an explicit empty value is saved. Metadata updates include only changed fields.
The review page sends ordered partial edits using each confirmed revision, blocks Apply/generation until saves finish, and blocks queued writes after any failed/uncertain save until reload.
Viewer/document departure invalidates queued writes and ignores old receipts; completed review controls are read-only. Existing route-role guards and canonical access rules remain unchanged.
